body:
### Dependencies
Requires Requires [Nova](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-framework) ([Installation Guide](https://docs.xenondevs.xyz/nova/admin/setup/))

# Simple Upgrades

Simple-Upgrades adds 5 upgrade types that are used in other Nova addons from xenondevs like [Machines](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-machines) or [Logistics](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-logistics).

![An image of the different upgrade types](https://i.imgur.com/9qho1qC.png)

**Speed**: Increases the speed of a Machine

**Efficiency**: Decreases the energy usage of a Machine
 
**Fluid**: Increases the fluid capacity of a Machine or of a Fluid Tank

**Range**: Increases the reach of a Machine
 
**Energy**: Increases the energy capacity of a Machine
